reviews.name: phase19-spec-review
reviews.note: Found that a panel closed under the pointer (row click, Esc) never got onHover(false), so the next card never closed on exit; also hit phase 15's needs-you panel. Also the scale anchor on the window-wide reader and the Idle capsule.

reviews.name: phase19-ponytail-review
reviews.note: One duplicated title label and comment order; confirmed the portal, Layout and statics were already minimal.

reviews.name: phase19-e2e-review
reviews.note: From CI recordings only: the card jumped wider when screen lines arrived, a stray card opened at launch under the last test's pointer, the card's workspace change was untested, the card sat 2 pt under the bar.

reviews.name: phase19-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Clean; checked the always-mounted overlay takes no hits and the Esc path; a test assertion in the wrong place.

reviews.name: phase19-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Clean; one why-comment and a doubled spec line.

reviews.name: phase19-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Saw the stray launch card still there (setUp moved the pointer too late); exact place asserts; showed the drag-test failure predates the phase.

reviews.name: phase19-verifier
reviews.note: PASS on every Build and e2e item with file:line and CI shards; found nothing new.

notes: GUI paused for most of the phase: CI was the test run (6 pushes; 3 runs cancelled by later pushes, one by another agent's push). The tooltip test cost two CI runs: macOS's help tag has no readable text in XCUITest and showed in one run of two; the test now reads the label (same string). The GUI came back near the end: one local run of the 4 hover tests. A phase 18 drag test raced on CI (isSelected read without a wait) and was fixed. One process slip: a shell chain removed another agent's GUI lock; recreated at once.
